    Loans: Our Services

    Financing for Rental Home Investors

    Long & Short-Term Financing for Single Family Properties or Portfolios. Fix & Flip or Buy & Hold.

    Equity Trac is a private real estate finance company that specializes in making private hard money loans from $100,000–Equity Trac emphasizes making loans to borrowers on investments that banks have difficulty financing because of the complexity of a deal, it’s timing or many other factors.


    When it comes to financing or refinancing your properties, you want to make sure you have a professional and experienced Broker by your side. I guarantee my clients the best financing and mortgage services. With Equity Trac, you’ll receive the best customer service as well as helpful, easy to digest resources to help you understand what’s really going on behind all those complicated numbers.

    ​

    Loan possibilities are endless. However, being overwhelmed by choice doesn’t mean you should take whatever is offered to you first. Contact us for information about different types of investor loans and we'll be happy to explain them and help you find one that suits your needs.

    ​

    Our capital is secured from our own fund, a network of private lenders, institutional lines of credit, and proprietary sources, enabling us to make quick decisions to fund real estate projects. The Equity Trac team understands real estate leverage and wants you to profit and repeat business with us. This is why Leverage - Profit - Repeat is our motto. We have experience in all major property types and look at each deal specifically.


    Our team has been involved with more than $275 million worth of real estate transactions in the past few years. We have done loans from coast to coast.

    ​

    We lend to all states except ND, SD, MN, AK & NV.
